description: List the paid orders the storefront reported (POST /orders, §3.3) for one rikma: ref, displayNumber, status (paid/shipped/fulfilled/cancelled), oversold, total, currency, buyer (name/email/phone — sensitive), delivery preference and address, payment ref/method, holder, paidAt/shippedAt/fulfilledAt, lines (productId/variantId, nameSnapshot, optionLabelSnapshot, skuSnapshot, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal) and sales. Members only — buyer contact leaves the server only inside a members-only response (§5.6) and is never copied to a webhook. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listRikmaOrdersTool

limit.description: Return at most this many, default 50.

oversoldOnly.description: Only orders whose stock ran short.

name: listRikmaOrdersTool
